text:
rina (packaging): heads-up: building sealed offline image for customer X. tag: private-vpc-3.4.0. pushing to staging registry then will request cosign. planning canary at 02:20 UTC in serial batches.

devon (infra): pushed to staging-reg.private:private-vpc-3.4.0. manifest sha256: c12a9f...d8e

mai (ops): queued for cosign with signer=signer-prod-03. suggestion: 15m hold after sign for smoke and hash reconciliation. ok? :point_up:  

jordan (sre): rollback policy: abort if >1% errors OR any node has repeated crashloop (>=2) during canary. also abort for median startup >12s.

rina (packaging): adding release note stub: "private vpc: improved offline install timeout handling; image shrinkwrap fix". will link final notes once packaging validated.

deploy-bot: cosign complete for private-vpc-3.4.0 by signer-prod-03. cosign:sha256:cc33ab...

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 02:20 UTC. targets: vpc-edge-alpha (2 nodes), vpc-edge-beta (1 node). TTL 20m. strategy: serial 2 then 1.

devon (infra): small sanity check you can run on staging nodes:
```
kubectl -n offline rollout status deploy/private-installer -w --timeout=30s || echo "rollout-not-ready"
```

mai (ops): smoke on staging returned OK. health endpoint: {"ok":true}. cold-start p50 ~3.2s.

jordan (sre): canary started. streaming logs to #release-monitor.

deploy-bot: vpc-edge-alpha node1 ok, node2 degraded (OOM at init). detected 1 crashloop.

jordan (sre): node2 crashlogs show allocator spike in connector prefetch. marking as failed and invoking rollback.

deploy-bot: canary halted at 02:25 UTC. executing rollback: promoting previous active tag private-vpc-3.3.8 and unpinning 3.4.0. Notifying oncall.

mai (ops): redeploying private-vpc-3.3.8 to node2. ETA ~3m.

devon (infra): opening quick patch to limit prefetch buffers and add guardrails; will run perf lab after rollback.

rina (packaging): quarantining 3.4.0 and marking release ticket REL-4987 with artifacts and logs. will not promote until fix validated.

jordan (sre): metrics back to baseline after rollback. median startup back to 2.8s. good.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 02:29 UTC. route restored to private-vpc-3.3.8.

mai (ops): I'll request cosign revocation for 3.4.0 and move signed manifest to quarantine bucket.

rina (packaging): thanks all. follow-up: perf stress with capped prefetch, then a trimmed canary window next Wed 06:00 UTC. attaching logs to REL-4987. :memo:
